study.question: Does the supplied coarse-summary polarity retain click utility at the primary residual adapter when its pivot-canonicalized replacement is compared with a continuous even readout of the same stateless adapter, at matched learned parameters and evaluated work?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: signed click-adapter coarse input scores0.6684190188831848 vs axis0.6667055157905444; direct source-gradient blocking retains the gap0.0018211966936282353 vs attached0.0017135030926404005. Earlier canonical/hash/path and full-view symmetrization controls underperformed, but those do not distinguish useful polarity from pivot canonicalization/optimization and consumer placement. Hypothesis: the forward signed coarse trend has useful polarity at this consumer, beyond what an even adapter response can exploit, rather than the entire axis deficit being a consequence of its discontinuous pivot. This is a local single-seed hypothesis, not a priority claim, new architecture claim, or proof of global chronology utility.

nearest_work.difference: Exact local architectural parent, full source and committed receipt inspected. Retain all learned modules and source ownership; only click-adapter output selection changes. The signed replay and axis replay connect to r0072; the earlier gradient factorial informs this question, not an independent replication.

Full committed config/note inspected: prior two-view reflection used joint 2B normalization, per-view BCE, all tasks/consumers and downstream prediction averaging. Here only the click Linear/ReLU/Linear adapter is averaged across c and -c before its original tower. No 2B input, extra tower/Dice view, label handling or loss hook is introduced.

Archived primary arXiv1706.06978v4 lines227-284 inspected: inherit candidate-conditioned unnormalized local activation as adapted in local code. DIN discusses an unsuccessful LSTM direction in its setting; that does not settle this benchmark. The present operation is a sign-even readout on one inherited ordinal summary, not a DIN reproduction or new-attention claim.

Considered as nearest pooled unified design; no hierarchical tokenizer/task tokens imported. Primary here means the pinned benchmark source, not verified equivalence to original author code.

inherited_components: All embeddings, 100-event input boundary, four task masks and official_offline historical feedback visibility; no event or mask permutation.
Ten-block uniform/feedback compression, folded primary support execution, independent auxiliary scorer moments and pruned eval path.
All five existing match/local/coarse/quadratic/joint summaries, task adapters, product context/history branch, original towers and initializations.
Parent primary signed/auxiliary axis/interaction axis consumers with attached primary coarse source gradient; inherited source ownership and one summed four-task BCE.
Frozen protocol, train seed20262027, single pass, batch8192, host optimizers/precision/scoring; unchanged incumbent retained as utility reference.
study.proposed_difference: At the primary residual adapter define f(x,c) with all prefix/sibling summary inputs x fixed. Execute f(x,c),f(x,-c),f(x,axis(c)) through the SAME stateless adapter in all three cells. Choose either FP32-averaged even output0.5*(f(x,c)+f(x,-c)), signed output or canonical-axis output, cast to native output dtype; retain other evaluations by algebraic zero terms in the backward graph. No new parameters/buffers, RNG use, task populations, towers, loss or raw-history changes. The even output is continuous in c at fixed siblings, whereas other inherited consumers still use the pivot axis. This replacement tests one local global-sign quotient, not arbitrary history permutation invariance.
predictions: If polarity explains a substantial part of the forward advantage, signed_bridge should exceed both even_readout and axis_bridge by a practically meaningful amount; predeclare0.0005 click AUC for S-E and S-A.
If pivot canonicalization/optimization explains most of the deficit, even_readout may recover to within0.0002 AUC of signed_bridge or exceed it, while beating axis_bridge by>=0.0005 when S-A>=0.0005.

Signed/axis controls should reproduce their r0072 treatments at common nonzero states and the frozen recipe; parameter counts should remain32192421 total/31793216 embedding/399205 dense. Actual cost, not parameter equality, determines the efficiency conclusion.

At fixed nonzero adapter weights even output must be invariant to c->-c with fixed siblings, while signed output may change. This invariant does not imply raw event-reversal or whole-model order invariance.
falsifiers: An even readout matching/exceeding signed with a clear advantage over axis weakens the proposed necessity of polarity at this consumer; do not call it evidence that supplied order is globally useless.
A deficit limited to axis and absent under even replacement contradicts an explanation based solely on missing sign information.

Failure of local even symmetry, native nonzero signed/axis bridge parity, input/gradient/moment ownership, or fixed parameter/state invariants invalidates interpretation until diagnosed; no frozen-contract change is permitted.
Inconsistent consequential gaps across later authorized paired seeds, or cost dominating any quality benefit, defeats a repeated utility/efficiency claim.
alternative_explanations: Axis pivot discontinuities and changing embedding coordinate orientation may impede optimization; even replacement avoids the pivot only at the primary adapter.

Equal learned parameter counts do not imply equal effective function capacity: a tied-width even ReLU readout restricts functions and may need more width. A null or negative even result alone cannot prove polarity utility.

Other supplied-order channels, block composition, sibling moments, primary scorer normalization and context interactions remain present; selected summary sign is not chronology, recency or global order invariance.

Single initialization, BF16 rounding/cancellation, frozen one-pass optimization and shared-parameter multi-task gradients may affect small differences; bridge replays are reproducibility controls, not independent evidence.
Previous whole-view averaging changed consumer placement, normalization populations and objective structure; its negative outcome cannot be attributed solely to losing this one sign.
Inherited whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots and delayed feedback visibility limit conclusions to official_offline benchmark utility, not point-in-time production or causal effects.
